name: Shelf Witness
description: A rotating collective of anonymous journalists broadcast live from Tier 1 using salvaged mesh nodes, documenting corponation security sweeps, illegal debt collection, and the slow disappearance of Shelf residents into private detention. Each episode ends with a dead drop location where physical evidence packages can be retrieved. The hosts have never been identified despite seven years of operation.
cultural_impact: Shelf Witness created the template for anonymous rotating-host pirate journalism that dozens of subsequent underground broadcasts have replicated across the Great Lakes corridor.
story_hooks: A player character receives a dead drop package containing footage that implicates a mid-level corponation security officer — who is also their contact
A Shelf Witness host is killed mid-broadcast, and the collective reaches out to the party to smuggle the evidence archive out of Tier 1
Someone has started a fake Shelf Witness feed distributing disinformation, and the real collective needs help identifying the source
